description: This is a Java test source file for integration testing savings interest posting in the Apache Fineract platform. It contains multiple test cases validating interest posting logic under various scenarios, involving account and product setup, interest accruals, and business date manipulations.

classes.name: SavingsInterestPostingTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing interest posting on savings accounts, including scenarios with overdraft and interest accrual, using the Fineract platform's API.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured configuration, sets up request specifications, and helper classes before each test.

methods.name: testPostInterestWithOverdraftProduct
methods.description: Tests interest posting on a savings account with an overdraft product, verifying correct interest application.

methods.name: testOverdraftInterestWithOverdraftProduct
methods.description: Tests interest posting when an account has overdraft enabled, ensuring overdraft interest is correctly calculated and posted.

methods.name: testOverdraftAndInterestPosting_WithOverdraftProduct_WhitBalanceLessZero
methods.description: Validates interest and overdraft postings when account balance goes below zero, with specific deposits and withdrawals.

methods.name: testOverdraftAndInterestPosting_WithOverdraftProduct_WhitBalanceGreaterZero
methods.description: Validates interest and overdraft postings when account balance remains above zero during interest posting.

methods.name: testPostInterestNotZero
methods.description: Verifies that interest postings are not zero when balance and transactions change over months.

methods.name: getInterestTransactions
methods.description: Filters and retrieves interest-related transaction records from an account's transaction history.

methods.name: createSavingsProductWithAccrualAccountingWithOutOverdraftAllowed
methods.description: Creates a savings product with accrual-based accounting rules, without overdraft enabled, configured with specific accounts.

methods.name: calcInterestPosting
methods.description: Calculates interest amount based on interest rate, principal, and days involved in the period.

methods.name: calcOverdraftPosting
methods.description: Calculates overdraft interest amount based on overdraft rate, principal, and days involved.

methods.name: coerceToLocalDate
methods.description: Converts transaction date information in a transaction record into a LocalDate object.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if a transaction date matches a specific expected date.

methods.name: txType
methods.description: Determines the transaction type of a transaction record.

methods.name: countInterestOnDate
methods.description: Counts the number of interest posting transactions on a specified date.

methods.name: countOverdraftOnDate
methods.description: Counts the number of overdraft interest posting transactions on a specified date.

methods.name: runAccrualsThenPost
methods.description: Executes accrual and post interest jobs sequentially.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Determines if a transaction has been reversed.

methods.name: assertNoAccrualReversals
methods.description: Asserts that there are no reversed accrual transactions for a given account.
